title: Multi-Agent Weighted Vote
hints: Normalize first: strip, lowercase, collapse whitespace with ' '.join(s.split()), then rstrip('.!?'). An empty result is an abstention.
Clamp each confidence into [0, 1] before adding it to its answer's score, and round scores to 9 decimals before comparing them.
Sort the candidates by (-score, -count, first_index). The reason is "tie_break" when more than one answer has the top score.
